name: Lilly
source:
Lilly is a visual novel about a transsexual girl who is going to a therapy session to see if she is ready to take the step. She feels that she is ready but is she truly?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27863]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《莉莉》是一部视觉小说，讲述了一名变性女孩要去接受治疗，看看她是否准备好迈出这一步的故事。她觉得自己已经准备好了，但她真的准备好了吗？

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27863]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
